title: ATTACHED FORM NO. 3 — Application for Certification as an Educational Donation Career Experience Institution
full_text:
ATTACHED FORM NO. 3 — Application for Certification as an Educational Donation Career Experience Institution
[Enforcement Rule of the Career Education Act]
Mark the applicable checkbox [ ] with a check mark (√).

[OFFICE USE]
Receipt number: __________   Date received: __________   Processing period: 6 months

[APPLICANT]
Name of institution (organization): __________________
Business registration number or corporate registration number: __________________
Location: __________________  Telephone number: __________________
Name of representative: __________________  Telephone number: __________________
Name and position of person in charge: __________________  Telephone number: __________________
Capital (in units of KRW 100 million): __________
Number of employees (persons): __________

APPLICATION
Pursuant to Article 19 of the Career Education Act, Article 9 of its Enforcement Decree and Article 4 of its Enforcement Rule, I hereby apply for certification as an Educational Donation Career Experience Institution.

Year: ____  Month: ____  Day: ____
Applicant: __________________ (signature or seal)
To: Minister of Education

[DOCUMENTS TO BE SUBMITTED BY APPLICANT]
1. One copy of documents concerning the institution's records of operation of career experience programs or results of self-assessment of such programs, if any.
2. One copy of documents concerning personnel and facilities necessary to provide career experience opportunities.
3. One copy of documents concerning the experience programs necessary for career experience.
4. All other documents concerning the provision of career experience opportunities.
Fee: None.

[MATTERS TO BE VERIFIED BY THE RESPONSIBLE PUBLIC OFFICIAL]
Certificate of registered corporate particulars (only if the applicant is a corporation), or certificate of business registration.

[CONSENT TO JOINT USE OF ADMINISTRATIVE INFORMATION]
I consent to the responsible public official verifying the above matters through joint use of administrative information under Article 36 (1) of the Electronic Government Act in connection with the processing of this application.
* If consent is not given, the applicant shall directly submit the relevant documents.
Applicant: __________________ (signature or seal)

[PROCESSING PROCEDURE]
Application completed (Applicant) → Receipt (Ministry of Education) → Examination (Ministry of Education / Certification Committee) → Approval (Ministry of Education) → Preparation of certificate register and certificate (Ministry of Education) → Issuance of certificate (Ministry of Education).

Paper size: 210 mm × 297 mm; white paper (80 g/m²) or medium-weight paper (80 g/m²).
